title: 亲子目的地筛选
prompt: 从杭州出发，周末带孩子玩两天，不想太累，有哪些地方合适？
program:
root = Col([intro, tool, tips, closing])
$pace = "轻松"
$age = "3-6岁"
$view = "filter"
$picks = []
intro = Text("从杭州出发，周末两天带孩子不累的话，优先选**平路多、可随时休息、室内外可替换**的地方。下面的时长和体力值为公开信息的估算，只作排序参考，请以景区当天公告为准。")
tool = TravelModule([viewSwitch, summary, $view == "filter" ? filterPane : planPane], "itinerary", "杭州亲子周末·两日轻松选", "示例数据：游玩时长与体力值为公开信息估算，不作为实际出行依据")
tips = Col([Title("怎么走更省力", "md"), Text("西湖只走断桥—白堤一小段，累了就坐电瓶车；西溪选电瓶船，不把两处湿地排在同一天。午后最热或下雨时把室内博物馆备选。", "sm", "muted")], 1)
closing = Text("本页面只做筛选和排列，不会创建订单或锁定门票。", "sm", "faint")
viewSwitch = SegmentedControl($view, ["地点筛选", "两日方案"], true)
summary = Col([Row([Title("两日清单", "sm"), Spacer(), Badge(@Plural(selectedCount, "处"), "info")], 2), selectedCount == 0 ? Text("还没有选地点，去“地点筛选”点加入。", "sm", "muted") : Row([Text("预计纯游玩 " + totalTimeText, "sm"), Spacer(), Text("节奏 " + $pace, "sm", "muted")], 2)], 2)
filterPane = Col([Col([Label("节奏"), SegmentedControl($pace, ["超轻松", "轻松", "适中"], true)], 1), Col([Label("孩子年龄"), SegmentedControl($age, ["3-6岁", "7-12岁"], true)], 1), Text(@Plural(@Count(filteredPlaces), "处符合") + " · 点击加入两日清单", "sm", "muted"), Col(@Each(filteredPlaces, "p", TravelItem(p.name, p.brief, [SearchImage(p.image, 1, "lg")], [Badge(p.duration + " h", "info"), Badge(p.tags, "purple")], [Button(@Includes($picks, p.id) ? "已加入" : "加入", @Set($picks, @Toggle($picks, p.id)), @Includes($picks, p.id) ? "soft" : "solid", null, "sm", @Includes($picks, p.id) ? "check" : "plus")])), 3)], 4)
planPane = Col([Text(planNotice, "sm", "muted"), planRows], 3)
planRows = @Each(twoDays, "d", TravelItem(d.place.name, d.place.brief, [DayBadge(d.day, d.date), SearchImage(d.place.image, 1, "lg")], [Badge(d.place.duration + " h", "info"), Badge(d.place.tags, "purple")]))
day1Id = selectedCount >= 1 ? @First($picks) : "west-lake"
fallbackDay2 = @First($picks) == "xixi" ? "west-lake" : "xixi"
day2Id = selectedCount >= 2 ? @First(@Slice($picks, 1, 2)) : fallbackDay2
day1Place = @Find(places, "id", day1Id)
day2Place = @Find(places, "id", day2Id)
twoDays = [{day: 1, date: "第1天", place: day1Place}, {day: 2, date: "第2天", place: day2Place}]
planNotice = selectedCount < 2 ? "当前已选 " + selectedCount + " 处，未选足两日时用示例地点补齐。" : "已按你的选择排出两日顺序。"
selectedCount = @Count($picks)
totalTimeText = @Duration(totalHours * 3600, "short")
totalHours = @Round(@Sum(selectedPlaces.duration), 1)
selectedPlaces = @Each($picks, "id", @Find(places, "id", id))
filteredPlaces = @Filter(byAge, "effort", "<=", effortMax)
byAge = @Filter(places, "minAge", "<=", ageNum)
ageNum = $age == "3-6岁" ? 3 : 7
effortMax = $pace == "超轻松" ? 1 : ($pace == "轻松" ? 2 : 3)
places = [{id: "west-lake", name: "西湖·断桥白堤", image: "西湖断桥白堤", brief: "沿湖平路走走停停，喂鸽子、坐游船，几乎不用爬坡。", duration: 2.5, effort: 2, tags: "游船/松鼠", minAge: 3}, {id: "xixi", name: "西溪湿地·电瓶船线", image: "西溪湿地摇橹船", brief: "坐电瓶船看芦苇和水鸟，中途上岸逛一小段。", duration: 3.5, effort: 2, tags: "观鸟/船游", minAge: 3}, {id: "zoo", name: "杭州动物园", image: "杭州动物园熊猫", brief: "动物集中，园区有缓坡和小火车，适合低龄娃。", duration: 3, effort: 2, tags: "动物/小火车", minAge: 3}, {id: "botanical", name: "杭州植物园", image: "杭州植物园草坪", brief: "大片草坪可野餐，步行少，还能看温室植物。", duration: 2, effort: 1, tags: "草坪/温室", minAge: 3}, {id: "wetland-museum", name: "中国湿地博物馆", image: "中国湿地博物馆", brief: "室内互动展厅，凉爽不累，适合午后或雨天。", duration: 1.5, effort: 1, tags: "室内/互动", minAge: 3}, {id: "liangzhu", name: "良渚博物院·鹿苑", image: "良渚博物院鹿苑", brief: "看玉器、喂小鹿，室内外结合不累。", duration: 2, effort: 1, tags: "博物馆/鹿苑", minAge: 3}, {id: "jiuxi", name: "九溪烟树", image: "九溪烟树溪水", brief: "溪水边踩水，路程平缓，适合稍大的孩子。", duration: 2.5, effort: 3, tags: "溪水/茶园", minAge: 6}]
